_note: Hand-corrected against grith v0.3.1 (crates/grith-server/src/routes/mod.rs, supervisor.rs and lib.rs). The upstream generator reads the curated crates/grith-docgen/data/api.toml, which is not derived from the router and is stale: it omits the /api prefix, lists four analytics routes deleted in 0.3.1, a GET /events WebSocket that never existed, and a POST /sync/configs write path. Re-running `npm run gen:references` will revert this file until that TOML is fixed in the grith repo.

auth_levels.open: No token, ever. Some of these still return 403 FEATURE_GATED on Community - open is not free.
auth_levels.dashboard: Dashboard token when one is configured; inert, and therefore open, when none is.
auth_levels.csrf: Dashboard token plus the x-grith-csrf header.
auth_levels.nonce: Single-use nonce carried in the callback URL. No CSRF layer.
auth_levels.pair-code: Single-use pairing code in the request body. No CSRF layer.
auth_levels.ws: Origin-versus-Host check, plus ?token=<dashboard token> when one is configured.

groups.name: Health & tier
groups.description: Liveness, licence state and the effective configuration. The three status reads never require a token.

routes.summary: Liveness probe: status, version, uptime and per-subsystem state, plus audit_quarantined / audit_read_only when the chain is not writable.
Plan tier, seats, session cap, renewal date, billing portal URL and the feature map the licence gate resolved.
Licence validity, seats, air-gapped flag, hours since the last refresh and the refresh state.
Read the effective configuration - every layer already merged.
Update configuration values at runtime.

groups.name: Proxy
groups.description: Filter pipeline state and dry-run evaluation. The dry-run has its own rate bucket at 20 rps.

routes.summary: Thresholds, allow / queue / deny counts and per-filter statistics.
Dry-run one tool call through all 18 filters. Body is {"tool_call": {...}}; the response carries composite_score, action, decision_reason, evaluation_time_ms, filters_evaluated and filter_results[].

groups.name: Digest
groups.description: The quarantine queue: calls that scored above 3.0 and at or below 8.0, held for a human.

routes.summary: List queued items awaiting review.
Clear the whole queue.
Approve this call and let it run.
Deny this call. The syscall returns EPERM.
Approve, and record the decision as an observation for the learned reputation table.
Mark the item escalated and dispatch an escalation notification.
Approve and trust this destination for the rest of the session.
Deny and terminate the originating process tree.
Approve and persist a learned rule for this call shape.
Apply a decision delivered through a webhook callback. Authenticated by the single-use nonce in the callback URL, so no CSRF header applies.

groups.name: Audit
groups.description: The hash-chained audit log of every decision grith made.

routes.summary: List audit records. Query: limit (default 20, max 100), offset, session_id, include=full|all.
Export records. Query: format=json|csv, limit (default 1000), include_cold, from_date=YYYY-MM-DD.
Exfiltration rollup over the last 500 records, top 10 destinations.
Decision counts for a window without rescanning the log. Query: window=today|7d|30d|all (default 7d), include=full|all. An unrecognised window falls back to 7d rather than erroring.
Fetch one audit record.

groups.name: Analytics
groups.description: The local analytics projection, read from the audit database. Free is a first-class server response, not a client-side mask over the Pro payload - the feature check runs before storage access.

routes.summary: Seven-day projection. Available on Community.
Thirty- and ninety-day projections. Gated on usage_analytics; returns 503 ANALYTICS_UNAVAILABLE when an older grith owns the audit database.

groups.name: Canaries
groups.description: Decoy credentials the canary filter watches for. Responses expose only id, label and a four-character value_prefix - never the token itself.

routes.summary: List registered canary tokens.
Register a canary token.
Remove a canary token.
Replace the value, keeping the label and id.

groups.name: Supervisor sessions
groups.description: Live supervised sessions. Nested at /api/supervisor, with both the dashboard-token and CSRF layers applied. The two session reads below sit outside that nesting.

routes.summary: List active supervised sessions.
Register a session.
Fetch one session's detail.
Terminate the session and its process tree.
Unregister the session.
Binaries pinned for this session.
Every wildcard-to-loopback listener clamp the supervisor performed. Note the path is /api/sessions, not /api/supervisor/sessions.

groups.name: Sync & policies
groups.description: Team policy and shared config pulled from grith.ai. Pro. No audit records are uploaded through any of these routes.

routes.summary: Cloud sync state and last successful pull. In the open bucket, but still returns 403 FEATURE_GATED on Community.
List synced team configs.
Merge synced JSON configs into team-config.toml in the config directory.
List team policies.
Fetch one policy.
Create a policy.
Update a policy.
Delete a policy.

groups.name: Dashboard & onboarding
groups.description: The browser bootstrap. Pairing is how a tab gets the dashboard token; the code is single-use and has no TTL.

routes.summary: Whether the first-run dashboard intro is still pending.
Dismiss the first-run onboarding card.
Mark the dashboard intro as seen.
Exchange a single-use pairing code for the dashboard token. Carries its own proof, so no CSRF header applies; a bad or spent code returns 401 PAIR_CODE_INVALID.

groups.name: Daemon IPC
groups.description: Loopback-only routes authenticated by the daemon bearer token in ~/.config/grith/daemon.token. Six of them carry no /ipc/ path segment, which catches people out. Rate bucket 10000 rps.

routes.summary: Dump the learned trust table.
Record one approve or deny observation.
Wipe the learned trust table.
Flush the trust table to disk.
Evaluate a live tool call. The learned reputation table is applied here, after the pipeline, and only when the pipeline returned QUEUE.
Extended proxy state including per-filter scores.
Append one audit record.
Append a batch of audit records in one round trip.
Pin a binary into the session inventory.
Enqueue a held call for review.
Fetch one digest item with full forensics.
Record the reviewed outcome for a digest item.
Expire items past the review timeout.
List registered sessions.
Register a session.
Reserve session capacity before the target is spawned, so a limit rejection can never arrive after the tool has run code.
Convert a reservation into a live session.
Cancel a reservation.
Evict sessions whose process is gone.
Fetch one session.
Update session metadata.
Unregister a session.
Terminate a session and its process tree.
The only event-injection endpoint. Body must be a JSON object with a type key, at most 64 KiB; success is 202.
Mint a single-use dashboard pairing code.
Shut the daemon down. Carries the IPC bearer as its proof, so no CSRF header applies.

groups.name: WebSocket
groups.description: The only two routes not nested under /api. No subscribe protocol and no heartbeat protocol: the server answers client Ping frames with Pong and ignores client text and binary entirely. Auth is Origin-versus-Host plus ?token=<dashboard token>, because browsers cannot set WebSocket request headers.

routes.summary: Live event stream. Frames are loose JSON objects: proxy_evaluation (two different shapes share the name), digest_queued / digest_reviewed / digest_escalated as {"type": ..., "item": <full DigestItem>}, server_shutdown, and three untyped supervisor frames with no type field at all.
The same stream narrowed to one session: only frames whose session_id equals the path id. 400 INVALID_ID on a non-UUID, 404 SESSION_NOT_FOUND if the session is unknown.
